BiblicalUsage: Jismakjah is Ismachiah, an Israelite, an overseer of the temple in the days of Hezekiah. In 2 Chronicles 31:13, Ismachiah, and Mahath.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Ismachiah matters because God works through ordinary people, and no name in His book is there by accident.
